name: Microsoft Copilot for Business
pricing_tiers: Microsoft 365 Copilot Business: ~$40/user/month bundled (includes M365 Business Standard + Copilot, July 2026 pricing). Previously: $30/user/month add-on on top of M365 ($12.50/user). SMB bundle (up to 300 users, no minimum). Promotional pricing available for existing subscribers who lock in before July 1, 2026.
free_tier_available: no — Copilot requires paid M365 subscription; free trial available for 30 days
latest_major_release: July 2026: new Copilot Business bundled SKU replacing $30 add-on model; Copilot in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Outlook continuously updated
key_capabilities: document generation (Word), data analysis and formula writing (Excel), presentation creation (PowerPoint), email drafting/summarization (Outlook), meeting transcription/summary (Teams), business chat across M365 data (Microsoft Graph grounding)
integrations: deep M365 ecosystem (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Loop); 1,400+ connectors via Power Platform; third-party: Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Adobe
smb_onboarding_time: hours to 1 day (tied to existing M365 tenant; Copilot activates immediately after license assignment)
mobile_support: Microsoft 365 mobile app (iOS/Android) with Copilot integration; Teams mobile with meeting recap; Outlook mobile with AI email assist
target_company_size: 1-300 for Copilot Business bundle; 300+ for Enterprise SKU
estimated_smb_users: 500,000+ SMB organizations using M365 Copilot (Microsoft FY2025 data); 75% of Fortune 500 use Copilot
market_differentiator: deepest productivity suite integration (Word/Excel/PPT/Teams); unique Graph-grounded data (pulls from user's emails, files, meetings); no data exfiltration — runs within tenant boundary
key_competitors: Google Workspace AI (Gemini), Notion AI, ChatGPT for Business
typical_roi_claim: Microsoft claims 70% time savings on first drafts, 29% faster task completion; Forrester study: 250% ROI over 3 years for enterprise
smb_adoption_trend: growing — Microsoft reports Copilot seats growing 60% QoQ; SMB-specific bundles introduced Nov 2025 to accelerate adoption; 82% SMB AI adoption rate (SBE Council 2026)
notable_smb_case_studies: 12-person Danish digital agency saved 10+ hrs/week per employee using Copilot (AutoCore AI case study); multiple SMBs reporting 5-10 hrs/week savings on admin tasks
funding_to_date: Microsoft: $211B annual revenue (FY2025); Copilot contributes to $30B+ annual AI revenue run rate (2026)
partner_ecosystem: massive: 400,000+ Microsoft partners globally; CSP program for SMB resellers; Pax8, SoftwareOne, Insight distribution; ISV ecosystem via Azure Marketplace
community_support: Microsoft Learn (free training), Microsoft Tech Community, Copilot Lab (prompt templates), extensive documentation, Partner Center for resellers
